checkpoint: First eligible verified price/confirmed-lineup capture in the last 15 minutes before the earlier advertised tipoff. Freeze the original price, source times, full five, probability and model/rules/protocol hashes; later revisions never replace that primary record.
eligibility: All five current-roster starters freshly confirmed; no Out/Doubtful or unresolved Questionable player; each of five has 20 prior same-team starts; selected player has three starter first-score wins and five losses. Retain supported negative offers and every exclusion.
primaryEvaluation: One binary decision per quoted eligible player-team-fixture at the checkpoint; lowest market ID breaks duplicate-market ties. Equal total weight per team-fixture, cluster both teams/players by fixture. Report binary Brier, log loss, calibration intercept/slope, reliability, coverage, phase/role/history and early-ten-team-game strata. Report six-outcome lineup diagnostics separately where the full outcome set is observed.
baselines: frozen uniform-starter baseline with explicit nonstarter residual
exact-market book break-even prices, without claiming they are true probabilities
marketBenchmark: No proportional de-vig of a five-starter list that omits the possible nonstarter scorer. Never combine both teams as one exclusive market. No game-first-basket or parlay probability inferred.

promotion.pairedImprovement: Both Brier/log loss must beat both frozen baselines on identical prospective observations, upper adjusted paired-loss bounds below zero; fixture-cluster bootstrap 2000 replicates seed 20261019 and weekly sensitivity, Holm-adjusted across evaluated markets.

recordingGap: Browser-local records are editable and depend on the view being open. Shared trusted pre-tip issuance and an independent expected-fixture ledger are still required for a verified public track record.
settlement: A nonstarter is a rule-indicated void even if they play or score first. Starter first scorer wins; other participating starters lose. Missing or conflicting PDF opening evidence remains pending/review. Actual account settlement and exceptional book rules remain unverified.
review: First two game days check engineering only. No interim outcome tuning; material changes begin a new version/cohort. Paper $1 returns are secondary and cannot prove actual customer execution. Criteria are chosen product gates, not guarantees.
